availability_states.known: A usable value is established by the applicable evidence.
availability_states.null: The applicable observation/analysis succeeded and explicitly yielded no value.
availability_states.unknown: The project cannot establish the value from available evidence.
availability_states.unavailable: The value cannot be reconstructed from the recorded evidence model (for example legacy UTC).
availability_states.unsupported: The applicable analyzer/capability does not support producing this value.
availability_states.not_applicable: The field does not conceptually apply to the item.
availability_states.stale: A value exists historically but is not authoritative for the current observation.

entities.definition: One File Organizer project database and its evidence/analytical state.
A root path selected for observation in a project; not automatically a custodian, device, or person.
Query subject representing a File Organizer file location/current state or a historical observation, depending on temporal mode.
Derived analytical hierarchy node from source-root-relative paths plus explicit directory events; not a fabricated file observation.
An exact-content grouping: current derived truth or a specific historical duplicate-run snapshot.
One analyzer result, or the current-relevant latest attempt under current temporal semantics.
A recorded member entry within an analyzed archive; not a filesystem file location.
A recorded File Organizer execution/run context.
One analyzer execution within a File Organizer run.

relations.semantics: Latest attempt for each analyzer on file_state.current_observation_id; never silently fallback to older success.
All stored analyzer results linked to observations for the location.
Group based only on authoritative current complete content identity.
Other/current locations in the same current exact-content group.
Recorded archive-member rows; negative absence requires complete archive evidence.
The source root containing the file location.

fields.label: Root Availability
fields.notes: Availability for the relevant run/scan context; not a permanent property of the root.

fields.label: Location ID
fields.notes: Durable location identity under one source root; not logical-item identity across move/rename.

fields.label: Folder
fields.notes: Analytical folder entity; not a fabricated filesystem observation.

fields.label: Logical Size
fields.notes: Length of the current observed file location; not allocated disk space.

fields.label: Physical Identity Known
fields.source: volume_serial IS NOT NULL AND file_index IS NOT NULL

fields.label: Filesystem Created UTC
fields.notes: True UTC only when timestamp_model supports it.

fields.label: Filesystem Created Local (Legacy/Naive)
fields.notes: Wall-clock value without reliable UTC interpretation where applicable.

fields.label: Filesystem Modified UTC
fields.notes: True UTC only when timestamp_model supports it.

fields.label: Filesystem Modified Local (Legacy/Naive)
fields.notes: Wall-clock value without reliable UTC interpretation where applicable.

fields.label: Filesystem Accessed UTC
fields.notes: True UTC only when timestamp_model supports it.

fields.label: Filesystem Accessed Local (Legacy/Naive)
fields.notes: Wall-clock value without reliable UTC interpretation where applicable.

fields.label: Content ID
fields.notes: Complete content identity only; authority requires current observation binding.

fields.label: Hash Authority
fields.notes: At minimum: current, stale, absent/unknown as defined by semantic contract.

fields.label: Potentially Reclaimable Exact-Duplicate Bytes
fields.notes: Unknown when physical identity is incomplete; not a deletion recommendation.

fields.label: PDF Page Count
fields.notes: P2.5 candidate for expression index or typed analytical fact.

fields.label: Extracted Text SHA-256
fields.notes: Trustworthy only after P1-CORR-001 or verified backfill.

fields.label: Extracted Text Storage Mode
fields.notes: Trustworthy only after P1-CORR-001 or verified backfill.

fields.label: Archive Entry Count
fields.notes: Trustworthy current completeness semantics require P1-CORR-002.

fields.label: Archive Listing Completeness
fields.notes: Values conceptually include complete, capped, summary_only; requires P1-CORR-002.

fields.label: In Current Exact Duplicate Group
fields.source: current exact-duplicate projection / authoritative current content identity
fields.notes: True only for present locations participating in an authoritative current exact duplicate group.

fields.label: Physical Object Key
fields.notes: Composite analytical identifier; never a logical-item identity.

fields.label: Filename Variants
fields.notes: Count of distinct current member filenames within the exact-content group.

fields.label: Extension Variants
fields.notes: Count of distinct current member extensions within the exact-content group.

fields.label: Logical Bytes Represented
fields.notes: Logical bytes represented by all locations; not reclaimable physical storage.

fields.label: Reported Author Evidence State
fields.notes: Values use P2.6 evidence vocabulary such as known, null, unknown, unsupported, not_applicable.

fields.label: Top-Level Folder
fields.source: first path segment beneath source root
fields.notes: Analytical hierarchy value; not a fabricated filesystem observation.

fields.label: Direct File Locations
fields.source: derived from current file locations whose parent is this folder

fields.label: Recursive File Locations
fields.source: derived from current file locations in this folder subtree

fields.label: Direct Logical Bytes
fields.source: sum of logical bytes for direct child file locations

fields.label: Recursive Logical Bytes
fields.source: sum of logical bytes for file locations in this folder subtree
fields.notes: Overlapping parent/child folder totals are expected; do not sum folders to calculate project total.
